summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Greentech SRL corporate site. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass for /api/health, /api/contact (POST/GET, validation 422, persistence, ordering desc, no _id leak), /api/newsletter (subscribe + 409 duplicate + 422 invalid), /api/stats shape. Frontend: header, hero, about, solutions bento (7 cards), BMS dashboard with Recharts (2 surfaces rendered), stats (4 metrics), testimonials (3), WhatsApp floating button with valid wa.me href, footer socials, smooth-scroll nav, mobile menu toggle on 390x844 - all working. Contact form end-to-end submission against public ingress returns success status-ok. Console errors: 0. Fixed one testability issue: data-testid was passed to react-fast-marquee which strips unknown props; wrapped the two Marquees in <div data-testid=...> so partners-marquee/clients-marquee are now queryable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside submit_contact (logger.info call). Currently works only because logging.basicConfig runs at import time and Python resolves names at call time, but it is fragile - move logger definition above the routes.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93).

POST /api/contact silently swallows datetime serialization edge cases - acceptable but consider returning a stable ISO string field rather than converting back to datetime in list_contacts (extra round-trip).
Newsletter: no email normalization (lowercase/trim) before duplicate check - 'A@x.com' and 'a@x.com' would create two entries.
Frontend Contact.jsx: empresa/interes are deleted from payload when empty, which is fine; but interes select has no max-length client validation matching backend's 120 char limit.
Partners.jsx: react-fast-marquee does not forward arbitrary props (data-testid). Fixed by wrapping. Apply same pattern if more 3rd-party components are used.
No rate limiting on POST /api/contact or /api/newsletter - public endpoints are spammable.
test_credentials: N/A - public corporate site, no auth
seed_data_creation: Test contact messages (TEST_ prefixed) and newsletter subscriptions (news_<uuid>@example.com) inserted via pytest. Safe to leave; do not pollute production data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (read from /app/frontend/.env). All API endpoints prefixed with /api. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. The site is fully Spanish, brand colors #A4D233 lime + dark zinc. Marquee testids now exist after wrapper fix. No auth flows exist.
rca of the issue: Single minor testability bug RCA: react-fast-marquee component does not spread unknown HTML attributes (data-testid) to the rendered root div. Reproduction: <Marquee data-testid="x"> -> rendered DOM has no data-testid. Mitigation applied: wrap each <Marquee> in <div data-testid=...>.
